quote: Insofar as a contradictory doctrine is intimated and held in Brown vs. State, 7 Tex. Ct. App. 619, that case is overruled.

In order to hold to the rule proclaimed today, we overrule any language to the contrary in Anderson, Pit-cock, Thompson, Pena, or any other case in Thompson’s line.
